name: Evercraft EarthWorks Autonomy
intents: reduce haul truck queueing at a quarry or aggregate site
reduce loader or excavator idle time waiting on haul trucks
optimize a load haul dump loop before buying autonomous equipment
simulate an earthmoving fleet before deploying physical autonomy
coordinate excavators haul trucks loaders and dozers with AI
find the bottleneck in a quarry material flow
site autonomy study for an aggregate operation
digital twin for quarry or earthmoving operations
shadow dispatch for haul trucks and loading equipment
figure out what part of my dirt operation is worth automating
vendor neutral autonomy orchestration for mixed heavy equipment
increase tons per hour by improving fleet coordination
study autonomous haulage without replacing my current equipment
evaluate automation for landfill bulk material or civil earthwork operations
authority: public discovery, paid site-autonomy study, simulation and shadow-mode planning for explicitly scoped material-flow loops; no production machine actuation authority is granted by discovery or study purchase
boundaries: software simulation and control-contract proof are not full-size physical deployment proof
modeled production gains are not observed site results
a paid study does not authorize production machine control
physical autonomy requires a separate controlled operating domain, verified equipment adapter, independent stop and takeover, heartbeat fail-safe, geofence and formal safety case
EarthWorks Compatible conformance is not certification
customer site data remains tenant scoped and cross-site learning requires permissioned or de-identified derived data
checkout or payment initiation is not payment proof; paid state requires authoritative Evercraft Payments verification

commercial.pricing: $5,000 one-time for the first three approved founding design-partner Site Autonomy Studies; planned standard price $7,500.

offers.name: EarthWorks Site Autonomy Study — Founding Design Partner
offers.scope: One approved site and one bounded material-flow loop.

commercial.payment_state: Buyer-specific Evercraft Payment Order is created only after explicit scope and purchase confirmation. Stripe is a settlement rail behind Raven Nexus, not the customer-facing payment product.
